name: Mercedes-Benz CLK GTR
description:
Mercedes Benz CLK GTR
Stock CLK GTR: 604hp / 572lb ft tq / Top Speed 214mph / 3,175 lbs
-6.9L V12 (Naturally Aspirated)
-The Guinness Book of World Records recorded the CLK GTR as the most expensive production car ever built at the time, with a price of $1,547,620(USD)

-Mercedes was obliged to finally deliver the required 25 road cars they had promised.

-Driver comfort and refinements were at a minimum as Mercedes-Benz wished to not only offer customers a true race car, but also to attempt to keep price low. Leather was used in the interior and an air conditioning system was offered. Two small storage lockers were also built underneath each upward swinging door. Traction control was also added for driver safety.
CLK Supersport: The Super Sport variant had the 7.3-litre V12 used in the Pagani Zonda which resulted in a total power output of 720 hp. Only 6 were built.
